title: Online MCA IoT – DSU Online | Apply for Smart Tech Careers
description: Master IoT with DSU Online MCA. Learn smart devices, embedded systems & industrial automation. Step into the future of connected technology & apply online today.

blocks.x: Online MCA Program - Internet of Things (IoT)
Sensor networks | Embedded systems | Communication protocols | Data collection & transmission | Industrial & home automation

This elective introduces sensor networks, embedded systems, and communication protocols. Learn how IoT devices collect and transmit data across smart homes, industrial environments, healthcare, and automation systems. Gain hands-on experience with IoT architectures, data acquisition, and practical applications that connect devices to create intelligent, responsive systems. By the end of the course, you will be able to design and deploy IoT solutions for real-world challenges.
Learn about various types of sensors, data acquisition, and how devices communicate in distributed sensor networks.
Understand microcontrollers, IoT boards, firmware development, and integrating hardware with software for smart applications.
Study protocols like MQTT, CoAP, HTTP, and Bluetooth to ensure reliable data transfer across IoT devices.
Implement IoT solutions for smart homes, industries, and healthcare, focusing on efficiency, monitoring, and automation.
Analyze data collected from IoT devices, visualize insights, and apply them to real-world automation and decision-making systems.
Design and implement IoT applications, connect sensors and devices, and develop firmware for smart solutions in homes and industries.
Develop embedded software for microcontrollers and IoT boards, ensuring efficient data collection and device control.
Manage communication protocols, network connectivity, and data transfer for sensor networks and connected devices.
Analyze IoT-generated data, visualize insights, and provide actionable intelligence for operational and business decisions.
Design end-to-end IoT solutions, integrate devices, cloud platforms, and analytics, and ensure scalability and security.
Implement IoT-enabled automation in homes, factories, and healthcare systems, optimizing processes and improving efficiency.
Integrate IoT devices with cloud platforms, manage real-time data streams, and develop scalable cloud-based IoT solutions.
Ensure the security of IoT devices, networks, and data, conduct vulnerability assessments, and implement protective measures.
Oversee IoT projects from planning to deployment, coordinate teams, and ensure timely delivery of IoT solutions.
Explore emerging IoT technologies, experiment with prototypes, and contribute to innovative smart solutions.
